submitted.rationale: EQE rises steeply toward the Fe-rich end: 0.68 Sb gave -0.003%, 0.51 gave 0.00005%, 0.30 gave 0.099%, 0.199 gave 0.78% and 0.181 gave 0.956%. Index 1 had the highest measured EQE. I read the XRD as Pt substrate peaks plus a rutile-type (FeSbO4-like) phase that grows as Sb increases, and possibly hematite. That fits Fe-rich compositions performing better, but the phase assignments are tentative.

rejected.reason: Sb 0.51, near rutile FeSbO4: EQE about 0
Not measured because the EQE budget ran out. Its XRD differs from indexes 2 and 4 (no 2.34 peak, weaker rutile peaks), so it may also be good.
